race.comment: MICHELANGELO (5) has to be a massive hope based on the Bathurst win six weeks ago. He has form in all sorts of metropolitan races, including in the Queensland Derby. The step back up to the mile has to help. Simply looks tough to beat. MICRO MIKKI (1) is finally getting out to a trip that suits more. He finished the race off so well at Coonamble. Will handle any sort of surface too. HAMMOON SENSATION (6) won a Highway first up and has been so consistent. Will be getting a sweet run all the way. HIBIKI HARMONY (7) hasn't been too far away of late and owns a decent record at this distance.
